title: Mazda Miata Engines by Year (1990–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the US Mazda MX-5 Miata by year, 1990–2026: the 1.6 and 1.8 B-series fours, the Mazdaspeed turbo, and the 2.0 MZR and Skyactiv-G.
intro: Mazda's two-seat roadster has been sold in the US since 1990, always with a four-cylinder engine. There was no 1998 US model; the second generation arrived as a 1999.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: First generation (NA)
intro: The 1.6 B6-ZE, then the 1.8 BP-ZE from 1994.

generations.name: Second generation (NB)
intro: The 1.8 BP, with variable valve timing from 2001 and the turbocharged Mazdaspeed in 2004–2005.

generations.name: Third generation (NC)
intro: The 2.0 LF-VE; automatics were rated lower.

generations.name: Fourth generation (ND)
intro: The 2.0 Skyactiv-G, revised for 2019 with a higher redline.
